stories.title: Japan Wins 7th Consecutive Asian Games Gold — Blanks China 7-0 in Run-Rule Final

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
SEVEN STRAIGHT. 🇯🇵

Japan blanked China 7-0 at Anjō Sports Park to claim its 7th consecutive Asian Games gold. Miu Goto threw 5 scoreless innings. Rei Fujimoto's walk-off single sealed it.

No dynasty in softball history like this.

#SoftballJapan #AsianGames2026
